feature_contract.goal: After genuine game D3D9 Draw/DrawIndexed, mirror a successfully authored StretchRect/UpdateSurface backbuffer postpass into the already native D3D11 full-size game RTV through a diagnostic bounded readback->GPU copy. Keep DX9Ex frame/input fallback, reject foreign/invalid regions. This hybrid path is NOT zero-copy full native gameplay or stereo XR proof.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Real successful D3D9 post-Draw destination pixels are read back, region copied to native D3D11 texture and further native game draws maintain source order.
Exact UpdateSurface source+destination and StretchRect destination region bounded, X8 alpha forced opaque, original full frame intact.

Failed D3D9 mutation, unsupported surface/format, device loss, malformed rectangle or out-of-budget event abort optional native publication without changing original game HRESULT, Draw, DX9Ex input, HMD routing.
Windows compile and all five mandatory DX11 gates pass at same SHA before target compare/fast-forward.

integration_path: Actual game authored D3D9 Draw/DrawIndexed -> existing native D3D11 geometry frame.
Successful original game UpdateSurface/StretchRect -> bounded current D3D9 destination readback -> D3D11 GPU CopySubresourceRegion preserving native output chronology -> existing Present bridge.
batch_components: D3D9 source hooks + native frame bridge C++ replay
portable destination region + C++ and Python negative source tests + fast CI wiring
